english.title: Employer fail to give to employee written particulars of redundancy payment
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an employer, on making a redundancy payment, failed without reasonable excuse to give to **(..SPECIFY EMPLOYEE..), an employee, a written statement indicating how the amount of that payment had been calculated
english.legislation: Contrary to section 165(2) of the Employment Rights Act 1996.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
employer make payment under s165(1) of Act
fail without reasonable excuse to give employee written particulars of how redundancy payment calculated

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 165 does not apply to a redundancy payment in pursuance of a decision of a tribunal which specifies the amount of the payment to be made(ii) Section 180(1) of the of the Employment Rights Act 1996 provides that where a body corporate is proved:-
(a) to have been committed with the consent or connivance of, or
(b) to be attributable to any neglect on the part of,
any director, manager, secretary or other similar officer of the body corporate, or any person who was purporting to act in any such capacity, he (as well as the body corporate) is guilty of the offence and liable to be proceeded against and punished accordingly.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, being an employer, on making a redundancy payment, failed without reasonable excuse to give to **(..SPECIFY EMPLOYEE..), an employee, a written statement indicating how the amount of that payment had been calculated.
